records.prompt: The Jerusalem wall is finished, Nehemiah 6:15-16. Animate this exact approved reference: three anonymous adult builders walk one careful step toward the completed gate. Retain the left worker's tool, middle worker's basket and right worker's mallet on his shoulder, with stable grips and believable weight. Keep all natural brown complexions, dark curls, ages, proportions, sandals and blue, green and brown mantles. They are anonymous, not new portraits of Nehemiah. No extra people, switching hands, opening gate leaves, falling masonry or legible writing. Natural blue daylight and green grass, realistic limestone and timber. Grounded lifelike realism, not a painting or glossy fantasy. No captions, text, logos, optional visible watermark, speech, dialogue, narration or music. Quiet natural location ambience only. Preserve actual uploaded reference identities, age, anatomy, geometry and lighting. One continuous restrained shot, subtle camera drift, no scene cuts.
